Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.

Key responsibilities:

- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.

Requirements:

- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer
description:
Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As the Tech Lead for our JavaScript/TypeScript full‑stack team, you will guide technical direction, drive architectural decisions, and serve as a key technical counterpart to our client stakeholders. You’ll be a great contributor to the code quality and security aspects, while actively coaching engineers to deepen the team’s expertise in our core stack. You’ll be hands-on and equally strong in communication—facilitating technical discussions, translating business needs into technical plans, and ensuring we commit secure, scalable, and high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • As a technical lead, be a reference when communicating with the team and stakeholders (including the client);
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Help define and document practices, methodologies and processes relevant to technical teams, improving Encora’s knowledge base;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Mentor less experienced team members.

Essential Skills

  • Broad experience with full stack development based in JavaScript;
  • Experience with analysis, design, and implementation;
  • Experience NextJS and NodeJS;
  • Cloud knowledge (specially AWS Lambda, AWS CDK and serverless).

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Knowledge about agile software development;
  • Experience in driving Scrum rituals (Planning, Daily, Review and Retrospective).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer

About the Role

This role is focused on backend development, specifically supporting the migration of our customer support platform from Zendesk to Gladly, as well as maintaining and extending the integration services that power our support operations.

You'll be embedded in a small, collaborative engineering team working directly with Customer Support and Ticketing Platform teams. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, take pride in owning your code end-to-end, and enjoy meaningful technical work — this role is for you.

What You'll Be Working On:

  • Lead and contribute to the ongoing migration of our customer support system from Zendesk to Gladly, with a go-live planned.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and integration layers within our Ruby on Rails monolith
  • Build and support internal integration services that connect our support platforms with core business systems
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and collaborative planning sessions
  • Own the quality of your work — writing tests, performing developer-driven QA, and ensuring production readiness without a dedicated QA engineer
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Support Representative (CSR) teams and ticketing platform stakeholders

Tech Stack:

  • Primary: Ruby, Ruby on Rails
  • Architecture: Rails monolith + separate integration services
  • Supporting: REST APIs, JSON, internal tooling

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Ruby development skills are a must
  • Solid experience building and maintaining backend services and API integrations
  • Comfort working without a dedicated QA team you own testing and production readiness
  • Experience working in Agile environments (sprints, code reviews, ceremonies)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Gladly and/or Zendesk
  • Background in platform migrations
  • Full-stack exposure (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) beneficial for potential future team movement
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or Kafka

title: Senior Software Developer (C# / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in C# and .NET to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop, and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms, particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystems, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers, having led the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using C# and .NET, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in C# and .NET
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications, and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands-on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team into tasks that can be accomplished within a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of the team to answer questions, resolve issues, and assess impacts on other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by the development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices, including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices, with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)
  • Knowledge of SaaS environments and SDLC methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Roadmap Release)
  • Knowledge in Business Intelligence tools, ETL, or reporting

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Corporate Content Creator
description:
Company Overview:

Lean Tech is a fast-growing technology company based in Medellín, Colombia, with a strong network in software development and IT services across the entertainment, financial, and logistics industries. The company offers significant opportunities for professional growth while working with engineering teams across Latin America and the United States on innovative projects. Lean Tech is seeking a Mid-level Corporate Content Creator & Training Evangelist to design and deliver high-quality multimedia training materials that communicate company initiatives, operational standards, and internal programs. This role combines content creation, instructional design, and corporate communication to transform complex operational and technical topics into clear, engaging materials such as documents, presentations, videos, and visual assets. The position will work closely with Operations, Product, Technology, Compliance, and Business Application teams to identify knowledge gaps and develop scalable training programs that enhance employee performance and operational excellence.

Position title: Mid-level Corporate Content Creator

Location: Remote - LATAM

Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Corporate Communication

  • Develop high-quality written content including structured documentation, manuals, process guides, and corporate communications using tools such as Microsoft Word and Visio.
  • Produce professional video content, visual assets, and multimedia training materials that effectively communicate company processes, systems, and initiatives.
  • Create engaging PowerPoint presentations, PDF learning materials, and visual storytelling assets for internal education and corporate messaging.
  • Design and produce multimedia learning content including tutorials, explainer videos, diagrams, infographics, and process walkthroughs.
  • Ensure all content follows corporate communication standards, branding, and messaging consistency.

Training Program Design & Instructional Development

  • Design, develop, and implement training curriculums tailored to employee roles and operational requirements.
  • Build structured learning programs including:
  • Best practices
  • Work instructions
  • Process documentation
  • Continuous improvement initiatives
  • Maintain and facilitate training curriculum, demonstrations, documentation, and certification programs for employees across different operational areas.
  • Develop training programs for New Hire Onboarding and Continuous Development, including defined milestones and certification expectations.
  • Create training frameworks that support different learning styles and modern learning methods (visual, video-based, interactive).

Training Delivery & Evangelization

  • Act as a corporate evangelist for training initiatives, promoting adoption of best practices and operational standards across the company.
  • Facilitate training workshops, demos, and learning sessions for internal teams.
  • Drive adoption of training content and learning initiatives through clear communication and engaging delivery methods.

Training Strategy & Performance Monitoring

  • Define and analyze training effectiveness metrics, measuring performance, adoption, and knowledge retention.
  • Monitor training program outcomes to ensure alignment with company standards, compliance policies, and operational procedures.
  • Continuously improve training content based on data insights, feedback, and operational changes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Business Application Owners, Operations Leadership, Product, Technology, and Compliance teams to identify training gaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Work with stakeholders across regions to ensure training programs reflect operational differences by region, station, carrier, mode of transport, or client requirements.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure data quality, process improvements, and workflow alignment within training materials.

Process & Content Governance

  • Maintain structured documentation repositories and ensure training materials remain current and aligned with evolving company processes.
  • Support workflow optimization and documentation standardization across departments.
  • Contribute to training roadmaps and long-term learning strategies.

Required Skills & QualificationsProfessional Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in content creation, corporate training, instructional design, or learning and development roles.
  • Proven experience producing multimedia training materials including documentation, presentations, video, and visual content.
  • Experience designing corporate training programs and internal knowledge frameworks.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and global organizations.

Content & Media Creation Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Visio or similar diagramming tools.
  • Experience creating professional training videos and visual content.
  • Strong understanding of instructional design and modern learning methodologies.
  • Ability to produce structured, well-written documentation with excellent editorial quality.
  • Experience with camtasia or other video and image editing.
  • Experience with Adobe reader or other tools to generate content

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong storytelling ability to transform technical information into engaging content.

Analytical & Organizational Skills

  • Strong research and analytical skills to identify training opportunities and learning gaps.
  • Ability to analyze training metrics and continuously improve programs.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple content projects simultaneously.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Strong collaboration skills across distributed and global teams.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous environments and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision.
  • Empathy for end users to design intuitive and practical learning experiences.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in corporate training, knowledge management, or learning experience design.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS).
  • Experience in global operations environments such as logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
  • Knowledge of project management frameworks and backlog management tools.

Why you will love Lean Tech:

  • Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology
  • Professional development opportunities with international customers
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels.

Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Full Stack - .NET Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 58724

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei #fera desenvolvedor, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando C# , Node.js e Python.
  • Vivência com serviços da AWS , incluindo Apache Flink, S3, EC2, ECS e SQS (entre outros serviços correlatos).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de microserviços , incluindo desenho, implementação e manutenção de serviços distribuídos.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
Vaga desenvolvedor Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior, você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas, APIs e serviços que compõem ao ecossistema de produtos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais:


  • Criar e manter APIs/Serviços, garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade.
  • Identificar e corrigir bugs, além de otimizar sistemas para melhorar a performance.
  • Trabalhar na integração de sistemas internos e de terceiros.
  • Participar de reuniões para entendimento de requisitos, refinamento de demandas e planejamento de sprints.
  • Escrever testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) para garantir a estabilidade das entregas.
  • Monitorar sistemas/serviços em produção, analisando logs e métricas para garantir a estabilidade e desempenho dos serviços.
  • Implementar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento, proteção de dados e autenticação de sistemas.
  • Em conjunto com a liderança técnica e arquitetura, avaliar e propor novas ferramentas, tecnologias e práticas para melhorar o ecossistema da empresa
  • Documentar processos e melhorias implementadas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência em Java e outras linguagens de programação. (experiência mínima de 4 anos )
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Habilidade para identificar e solucionar desafios técnicos de forma eficiente.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código com Git;
  • Noções de banco de dados PostgreSQL e Mongo;
  • Experiência com Quarkus ou Spring Boot ;
  • Busca constante por melhorias nos sistemas e processos existentes.
  • Capacidade de documentar código e comunicar ideias técnicas de forma clara.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas: Busca contínua por aprendizado e soluções eficazes. Capacidade de colaborar em equipe, receber feedback construtivo e contribuir para o sucesso do projeto


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com sistemas legados desenvolvidos a partir do Java 8;
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação Node, Typescript, React e Angular;
  • Familiaridade e experiência com o uso de Docker para implantação e gestão de contêineres;
  • Experiência prévia com aplicativos de gerenciamento de caches e/ou sistemas de filas de eventos.



Por que #VemParaSyonet ? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente

title: Executive Headhunter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Executive Headhunter position focuses on identifying, attracting, and assessing top talent for senior-level positions. This role combines executive search methodology with talent assessment expertise to place high-performing leaders who can drive organizational success and strategic growth for clients.

Key responsibilities:

- Conducting in-depth interviews and evaluations to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, cultural fit, and potential.

- Designing and executing customized search strategies to identify high-caliber talent for executive or senior-level roles.

- Facilitating the offer process, including salary negotiations and contract discussions, to ensure smooth placements.

- Proactively identifying and attracting top-tier candidates through networking, referrals, market research, and digital platforms.

Requirements:

- Experience: At least 5 years in recruitment, preferably in executive search.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Psychology, Human Resources, or related field.

- Market Knowledge: Experience recruiting for US candidates and commercial openings.

- Assessment Skills: Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.

- Industry Understanding: Knowledge of various industries and executive roles.

- Work Style: Ability to work independently and manage multiple search assignments.

- Language Skills: Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Executive Headhunter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

The Executive Headhunter position focuses on identifying, attracting, and assessing top talent for senior-level positions. This role combines executive search methodology with talent assessment expertise to place high-performing leaders who can drive organizational success and strategic growth for clients.

Key responsibilities:

- Conducting in-depth interviews and evaluations to assess candidates' qualifications, experience, cultural fit, and potential.

- Designing and executing customized search strategies to identify high-caliber talent for executive or senior-level roles.

- Facilitating the offer process, including salary negotiations and contract discussions, to ensure smooth placements.

- Proactively identifying and attracting top-tier candidates through networking, referrals, market research, and digital platforms.

Requirements:

- Experience: At least 5 years in recruitment, preferably in executive search.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Psychology, Human Resources, or related field.

- Market Knowledge: Experience recruiting for US candidates and commercial openings.

- Assessment Skills: Excellent interviewing and candidate assessment abilities.

- Industry Understanding: Knowledge of various industries and executive roles.

- Work Style: Ability to work independently and manage multiple search assignments.

- Language Skills: Advanced level of English.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.

Position Overview:

For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems

Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Hunter Comercial
description:
O profissional será responsável por toda a jornada de prospecção e qualificação de novos leads, desde a abordagem inicial até a elaboração e apresentação de propostas de serviços da empresa. Atuará estrategicamente para identificar novas oportunidades de negócio, realizar abordagens ativas e engajar leads com as soluções oferecidas pela empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar ativamente contas estratégicas e decisores B2B;
  • Realizar o atendimento de novos leads provenientes do Inbound MKT;
  • Realizar abordagens iniciais para identificar necessidades e desafios dos leads;
  • Realizar a qualificação de leads, conforme processo interno;
  • Elaborar e apresentar propostas aos leads qualificados;
  • Realizar follow-up de negociações e acompanhamento de novos contratos;
  • Monitorar métricas, metas e OKRs relacionadas à prospecção e qualificação de leads;
  • Contribuir com insights para a melhoria contínua das estratégias comerciais da empresa.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência ou formação na área de energia elétrica
  • Experiência com prospecção ativa e vendas B2B
  • Técnicas de qualificação de leads e vendas consultivas
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas CRM

Informações:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto;
  • Salário fixo + variável (formato OTE);
  • Cartão iFood;
  • PLR com distribuição anual;
  • Contrato PJ *;

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;

  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

title: Senior Software Engineer - C#
description:
About the Company

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer, based of Argentina or Brazil, with a strong specialization in C#, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex .NET / C# based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.

Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Develop strategies for transitioning from legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer with a strong focus on C#.
  • Proficient in .NET Framework/.NET Core.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Strong knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices, event driven architecture and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure or Google Cloud for development and deployment.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies (e.g., React, Angular) is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Fully remote position, with the opportunity to travel to the US.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

title: Semi Senior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role

The Semi Senior Java Developer position focuses on developing and optimizing complex applications using advanced Java skills. This role involves enhancing system performance, implementing sophisticated features, leading smaller project teams or modules, and mentoring junior developers while playing a crucial part in development projects and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Key responsibilities

- Designing and developing complex Java applications, demonstrating strong problem-solving capabilities and technical expertise.

- Leading smaller project teams or modules, guiding junior developers and ensuring project timelines and coding standards are met.

- Conducting thorough code reviews, enforcing best practices for high-quality, maintainable code across the team.

- Staying updated with advanced Java features and frameworks while mentoring junior team members in their professional development.

- Collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, translating technical and business requirements into robust, scalable solutions.

- Contributing significantly to project planning and execution, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.

Requirements

- Java Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience with Java development.

- APIs and Web Services: Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and Web Services.

- Database Technologies: Practical experience with database systems and data management.

- Algorithm Knowledge: Advanced understanding of algorithms and data structures.

- Infrastructure Basics: Basic IT infrastructure knowledge and deployment practices.

- Software Design: Experience in designing and implementing software modules for real-world applications.

- Testing Proficiency: Proficient in writing and implementing unit tests.

- CI/CD Familiarity: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior AI Engineer – RAG & MCP (Integrations & Tools)
description:
Remote | Full-time | Voiceflip

Employee located in South America prefered.

Salary $1,200-2,000 usd / month

We’re hiring a senior AI engineer to own RAG systems, MCP, and tool integrations for ARDI — our production AI assistants used by real estate associations and MLSs across North America.

This role is for someone who enjoys turning messy data + APIs into reliable AI tools.


Not prompt hacking. Not research.


What you’ll do

  • Build and improve production RAG pipelines
  • Design and operate MCP servers and tools
  • Connect ARDI to new APIs, datasets, and systems
  • Improve grounding, retrieval accuracy, and trust
  • Debug hallucinations by fixing retrieval and context
  • Work closely with product and customers on real use cases

What we’re looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience with RAG systems
  • Real experience with MCP and tool orchestration
  • Python in production environments
  • Vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
  • Experience with ingestion pipelines and unstructured data
  • Senior-level judgment: you know why things break

Nice to have

  • Azure or cloud-native deployments
  • AI agents / multi-tool systems
  • Search, IR, or NLP background
  • Enterprise or regulated data experience

Why this role

  • Small, senior team
  • Real product-market fit
  • You’ll shape the architecture, not inherit chaos
  • Focus on accuracy, accessibility, and trust

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.

Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.

Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.

Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

title: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix
description:
Vaga: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix

Local: Brasil (remoto)

Área: Produto / Tecnologia / Varejo

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner especialista em ERP Linx Microvix para liderar a evolução de soluções voltadas ao varejo. Este profissional será responsável por traduzir necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades de produto, garantindo que o ERP atenda às demandas operacionais, fiscais e estratégicas de redes varejistas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Definir e gerenciar o roadmap do produto relacionado ao ERP Linx Microvix.
  • Priorizar e organizar o backlog de produto , criando e refinando user stories.
  • Traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros para o time de desenvolvimento .
  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre stakeholders e equipes técnicas .
  • Conduzir sessões de refinamento de backlog, planejamento de sprints e reviews .
  • Definir critérios de aceite e validar entregas do time de desenvolvimento.
  • Mapear processos de varejo e propor melhorias operacionais dentro do sistema.
  • Participar da definição e acompanhamento de releases e versões do produto .

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada com ERP Linx Microvix .
  • Experiência como Product Owner, Product Manager ou Analista de Produto .
  • Conhecimento profundo de operações de varejo .
  • Experiência com metodologias Agile / Scrum .
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação funcional e regras de negócio .
  • Conhecimento em integrações de sistemas e APIs.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com POS de varejo ou soluções omnichannel .
  • Conhecimento em meios de pagamento e carteiras digitais
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia voltadas para varejo.

Competências comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico
  • Comunicação clara entre áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Visão estratégica de produto

title: Astound Us Open Call for Illustrators
description:
At Astound Us we are Drawn to better. We aim high, to Astound, by being the agency with the best in contemporary children's book illustration, licensing, and commercial art.

We invite freelance illustrators to submit their work to be considered for representation and to join our roster of artists. This is a fully remote role , enabling you to work from anywhere in the world while building your global reputation as an illustrator.

Here at Astound Us we work closely with our artists to ensure career advancements with the right clients, regular creative guidance , storybook development , direct connections with clients suited to your style, strong administrative support and on-time payment .

We would love to review your work, so there's absolutely no cost associated with your submission.

All submissions are processed by our talent scouts at ITSme , and reviewed in conjunction with our Astound agents.

In order to submit your work, please send a collection of images or a link to your online portfolio/ website to along with some information about you. We will review this and get back to you if you are the right fit to become represented by illo.

To find out more about ITSme and our submission process, please visit:

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar funcionalidades em Apex (triggers, services, batch/queueable/schedulable), garantindo bulkification, testes e respeito aos limites da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver Lightning Web Components (LWC) com arquitetura limpa, performance, consumo de dados via LDS/wire e chamadas @AuraEnabled.
  • Construir e manter integrações (REST/SOAP): callouts com Named Credentials, autenticação (OAuth/JWT), tratamento de erros e observabilidade (logs/monitoramento).
  • Atuar no ecossistema de Service Cloud & Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp, Bots), integrando fluxos de atendimento e automações.
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debug logs, trace flags, Event Monitoring) e otimizações de performance/consultas.
  • Versionar e implantar com SFDX + Git (branching, code review, qualidade de código).
  • Garantir segurança e compliance (FLS/CRUD, compartilhamento, transações) e produzir documentação técnica de suporte às entregas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Forte experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce (Pleno/Sênior) com foco em Service Cloud.
  • Domínio de Apex, SOQL/SOSL, padrões assíncronos e testes unitários (qualidade e cobertura).
  • Experiência com LWC (JS moderno, componentização, comunicação com Apex).
  • Vivência com Digital Engagement (Chat/Messaging/WhatsApp), incluindo implementação técnica e integração com processos de atendimento.
  • Integrações via API REST/SOAP em Apex (Named Credentials, serialização JSON/XML, tratamento de exceções).
  • Troubleshooting e análise de logs em ambientes produtivos e sandboxes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de governor limits e estratégias de otimização.
  • Prática com Salesforce DX e Git (pull requests, code review).
  • Certificações: Platform Developer I

CLT, salário a combinar+ benefícios.

100% remoto.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Business Analyst (BA)
description:
I am reaching out because we are in need of a new Business Analyst (BA) resource for our team, and I would like to request your support. Below are the details of the profile we are seeking:

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) to join our team and support initiatives related to our Core Banking systems. This professional will act as a key bridge between business and technology, ensuring clarity of requirements, alignment across teams, and effective delivery of solutions in an Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support Agile ceremonies, including:
  • Daily Scrum (when necessary)
  • Backlog Refinement
  • Sprint Planning
  • Sprint Review
  • Sprint Retrospective (as observer or contributor)
  • Conduct requirements gathering and process analysis
  • Prepare and maintain the product backlog
  • Organize and manage dependencies across teams
  • Validate deliverables to ensure alignment with business needs
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders
  • Leverage JIRA for tracking, documentation, and workflow management

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Experience with Core Banking systems, including:
  • DDA Accounts
  • Savings Accounts
  • Money Market Accounts
  • Certificates of Deposit (CD)
  • Hands-on experience working in Agile teams
  • Strong knowledge of banking processes and system integration
  • Proven experience with:
  • Requirements gathering
  • Backlog preparation and refinement
  • Dependency management
  • Delivery validation
  • Proficiency with JIRA

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with JHA (Jack Henry & Associates) environment

title: Advogado (a) Sênior | Contencioso Cível Estratégico
description:
QUEM SOMOS


TozziniFreire é um escritório full-service com atuação em 55 áreas do Direito Empresarial. Nosso compromisso com a integridade, a responsabilidade social e diversidade e a inclusão social está expresso em nossa missão e é reforçado diariamente em nosso desempenho.


INOVADORES ATÉ PARA INOVAR

Somos pioneiros no desenvolvimento de um programa de inovação interno, o ThinkFuture, que prepara nossos advogados para as transformações digitais e já é referência jurídica nos assuntos que envolvam tecnologia.


NOSSA ATUAÇÃO

Nossa equipe de contencioso cível estratégico é premiada e reconhecida pelo mercado e pelos principais guias nacionais e internacionais. title: Estágio em Design de UI
description:
Company Description

Pixel Breeders specializes in transforming visionary concepts into cutting-edge technology solutions tailored for startups and innovative projects. The company focuses on software development, AI-driven solutions, and technology consultancy to help clients launch, scale, and optimize their products. Our expertise lies in building scalable systems using the latest AI technologies, automation, and data-driven insights to create impactful and future-proof products. Pixel Breeders is dedicated to empowering startups and innovators by delivering custom tech solutions that drive success and open new opportunities. Collaborate with us to bring new ideas to life and shape the future of technology.


Role Description

This is an internship remote role for a UI Design Intern at Pixel Breeders. The selected candidate will assist in creating user-centered designs, building intuitive user interfaces, conducting usability testing, and collaborating with developers and product teams. Responsibilities will also include iterating on designs based on feedback, staying updated on design trends, and assisting in delivering pixel-perfect UI assets for various projects.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in UI Design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD
  • Proficiency in general design-related tools such as Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Knowledge of wireframing, prototyping, and creating design systems
  • Comfort with conducting user research and usability testing
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsiveness in web and mobile design
  • Strong attention to detail, creativity, and ability to work in team collaborations
  • Good communication skills for discussing design decisions and receiving feedback
  • A keen interest in staying updated with UI/UX design trends and best practices
  • Enrollment in a relevant field of study such as Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or similar


How to Apply

Simply fill the form below and don't forget to attach your portfolio - applications with no portfolio will be summarily ignored.

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for HungerRush Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all HungerRush Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Provide first class Technical Support over the phone
  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls
  • Work closely with other departments to provide prompt resolutions to customer

issues

Education :

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)
  • Preferred – Associates Degree (or higher)

Experience:

  • Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in computer technology (prior help desk or call center experiences supporting a software product a big plus)
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Technical certifications (examples: Net+, CompTIA A+ or an AAS degree or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in the hospitality industry
  • Familiarity with POS equipment
  • Bilingual Speaker (preferable) (Spanish/English)

What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

title: Veterinarian
description:
About SignalPET

SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.

We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.

The Role

As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.

You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.

This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:

  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing

Key Responsibilities

Academy & CE Content Development

  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform

Medical Marketing Content

  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation

Workflow-Connected Learning

  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities

Performance & Optimization

  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation

Requirements

  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms

Working Hours

  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm

*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***

This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.

Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.

We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

Why Join SignalPET?

  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

title: Professor de inglês
description:
A Town English School é uma escola especializada no ensino de idiomas para profissionais do mundo corporativo, focada em oferecer uma experiência de aprendizado diferenciada e de alta qualidade. Estamos em busca de professores de inglês qualificados para ministrar aulas online e contribuir com a criação de materiais didáticos.

O que buscamos em você:

Procuramos um profissional que compartilhe dos nossos valores, que inclua:

  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaboração constante com o time pedagógico e administrativo.
  • Boa comunicação: Capacidade de se expressar claramente e dar feedback construtivo.
  • Boa organização: Gerenciamento eficaz de turmas, atividades e prazos.
  • Adaptabilidade: Prontidão para ajustar planos de aula conforme necessário.
  • Dinamismo: Abordagem ativa e interativa em sala de aula.
  • Foco em resultados: Compromisso em acompanhar o progresso dos alunos.
  • Paixão pelo aprendizado: Estímulo ao crescimento contínuo dos alunos e de si próprios.
  • Amigável: Criação de um ambiente acolhedor e positivo para os alunos.
  • Abertura ao feedback: Capacidade de receber e seguir feedbacks da equipe pedagógica e adaptar suas aulas de acordo com as orientações da escola.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Ministrar aulas de inglês online com foco nos objetivos e necessidades dos alunos.
  • Comunicar-se regularmente com o time para alinhamento de estratégias e metodologias.
  • Corrigir atividades e fornecer feedback claro e construtivo para os alunos.
  • Participar no planejamento personalizado do aprendizado de cada aluno.
  • Preencher planilhas e manter histórico de aulas de maneira organizada e atualizada.
  • Utilizar aplicativos de gerenciamento de tarefas para controle de progresso.
  • Contribuir com a criação e adaptação de materiais didáticos quando necessário.

O que oferecemos:

  • Material didático completo e atualizado.
  • Suporte contínuo da equipe pedagógica.
  • Treinamento para aperfeiçoamento contínuo de técnicas de ensino.
  • Flexibilidade de horários para atuar remotamente.
  • Remuneração por hora-aula.
  • Valores diferenciados de hora-aula conforme o tipo de aula ou turma.
  • Bonificação baseada em desempenho e progresso dos alunos.

Carga horária:

  • Professores iniciam com uma carga horária reduzida.
  • O número de turmas aumenta progressivamente de acordo com desempenho, disponibilidade e demanda de alunos.

Requisitos para a vaga:

  • Formação completa ou em andamento em Letras, Pedagogia, Educação, ou áreas afins.
  • Inglês avançado (C1 ou C2 - CEFR).
  • Experiência prévia no ensino de inglês.
  • Afinidade com os valores da escola.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de videochamada e ferramentas tecnológicas para ensino à distância.
  • Abertura para receber feedback e ajustar práticas de ensino conforme orientações.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações internacionais de proficiência ou ensino de inglês (Cambridge, IELTS, TOEFL, CELTA, TESOL, TEFL).
  • Experiência com Business English ou ensino de inglês para profissionais do meio corporativo.
